title: models/telemetry
description:
A standard point of vehicle telemetry. References to latitude and longitude imply coordinates encoded in the
[WGS 84 (EPSG:4326)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Geodetic_System) standard GPS or GNSS projection expressed
as [Decimal Degrees](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Decimal_degrees).

device_id.description: A unique device ID in UUID format.

provider_id.description: A UUID for the Provider, unique within MDS. See MDS [provider list](https://github.com/openmobilityfoundation/mobility-data-specification/blob/main/providers.csv).

data_provider_id.description: If different than `provider_id`, a UUID for the data solution provider managing the data feed in this endpoint.

telemetry_id.description: ID used for uniquely-identifying a Telemetry entry.

oneOf.description: If telemetry occurred during a trip, the ID of the trip(s).
If not in a trip, null.
If telemetry occurred during a trip and journeys are used for the mode, the ID of the journey.
If not in a trip, null.

stop_id.description: Stop that the vehicle is currently located at.

battery_percent.description: Percent battery charge of vehicle, expressed between 0 and 100.

fuel_percent.description: Percent fuel in vehicle, expressed between 0 and 100.

tipped_over.description: If detectable and known, is the device tipped over or not?

altitude.description: Altitude above mean sea level in meters.

heading.description: Degrees - clockwise starting at 0 degrees at true North.

satellites.description: Number of GPS or GNSS satellites.

speed.description: Estimated speed in meters / sec as reported by the GPS chipset.

data-types_integer-positive.title: data-types/integer-positive
data-types_integer-positive.description: An integer greater than or equal to 0.

data-types_uuid.title: data-types/uuid
data-types_uuid.description: A UUID used to uniquely identity an object.
